title: Magic wand with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Wand stick - warm brown with lighter highlight -->
  <rect x="45" y="38" width="10" height="52" rx="4" fill="#C97B3A"/>
  <rect x="47" y="38" width="3" height="52" rx="1.5" fill="#E8A968"/>
  <!-- Wand tip / star shape - bright yellow -->
  <polygon points="50,4 57,22 76,22 61,34 66,52 50,41 34,52 39,34 24,22 43,22" fill="#FFD93B" stroke="#FFB800" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- Star inner highlight -->
  <polygon points="50,12 54,24 66,24 57,32 60,44 50,37 40,44 43,32 34,24 46,24" fill="#FFF3A0" opacity="0.6"/>
  <!-- Smiling face on star center - dark slate blue for LED visibility -->
  <!-- Left eye -->
  <circle cx="43" cy="28" r="3" fill="#2E2E5E"/>
  <!-- Right eye -->
  <circle cx="57" cy="28" r="3" fill="#2E2E5E"/>
  <!-- Eye glints -->
  <circle cx="44" cy="27" r="1" fill="#8ECAE6"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="27" r="1" fill="#8ECAE6"/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d="M42 34 Q50 42 58 34" stroke="#2E2E5E" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Rosy cheeks -->
  <circle cx="38" cy="34" r="3" fill="#FF8FAB" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="34" r="3" fill="#FF8FAB" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- Sparkles around the wand -->
  <circle cx="22" cy="14" r="2" fill="#FFE066"/>
  <circle cx="80" cy="10" r="2" fill="#FFE066"/>
  <circle cx="88" cy="30" r="1.5" fill="#FFE066"/>
  <circle cx="14" cy="32" r="1.5" fill="#FFE066"/>
  <circle cx="75" cy="48" r="1.5" fill="#FFE066"/>
  <circle cx="25" cy="48" r="1.5" fill="#FFE066"/>
</svg>
